title: Slack CLI hooks
description: The CLI-SDK interface used for the ".slack/hooks.json" project file and the "get-hooks" hook response. Read more: https://docs.slack.dev/tools/slack-cli/reference/hooks

runtime.description: The target runtime for app functions. For apps deployed to Slack's managed infrastructure, the only accepted value is "deno".

hooks.description: Commands for each hook. The CLI runs each command in a shell and appends flags in the "--name=value" format, so commands must ignore unknown flags or end with "#".

build.description: Bundles the app for deployment to Slack's managed infrastructure. Receives the "--source" and "--output" flags.

check-update.description: Checks for updates to the SDK and project dependencies.

deploy.description: Deploys the app when running the "deploy" command.

doctor.description: Returns runtime and dependency versions for the "doctor" command.

get-hooks.description: Returns the default CLI-SDK interface. Values in the "hooks.json" file override the response.

get-manifest.description: Prints the app manifest as JSON. Receives the "--source" flag. If this hook isn't defined, the "manifest.json" file in the project root is used.

get-trigger.description: Prints a trigger definition as JSON. Receives the "--source" flag.

install-update.description: Installs updates to the SDK and project dependencies.

start.description: Starts the app server when running the "run" command.

protocol-version.description: Protocols supported by the SDK in order of preference. The default protocol is used if not provided.

sdk-managed-connection-enabled.description: If true, the SDK manages the Socket Mode connection during the "run" command. Otherwise the CLI manages the connection.

trigger-paths.description: Paths to files of trigger definitions.

manifest.description: Files that reinstall the app when changed.

app.description: Files that restart the app server when changed.

hook.description: A command to run in a shell.

paths.description: File paths or directories to watch.

filter-regex.description: A regular expression of file names that trigger changes.
